_setupNote: Self-provisions all three buckets. Local: creates ui monitors. Heartbeat: bulk-indexes fake autodiscovery pings (no minikube) — reads ES from QA_KIBANA_DIR/config/kibana.dev.yml. Remote: flips the CCS `useAllRemoteClusters` setting; only shows data if this is a remote (edge-oblt) setup.
